messages:
Jules (Eng Manager): Quick question: we're planning a mid-cycle level bump for Alex (US) from IC2 -> IC3 with a comp increase. Do we file this as a mid-cycle promotion or just a comp adjustment? Need to know approvals and timing before I tell Alex.
Priya (People Ops): Hi! :wave: If it's a level change (IC2 -> IC3) we route to the leveling committee + comp approval. If it's just a pay adjustment within same level, it's the comp-change flow. Since this is a promotion, submit the leveling packet (1-paragraph business case + org chart + direct report plan if applicable).
Jules (Eng Manager): No direct reports. It's a scope/impact bump. What docs do you need exactly?
Priya (People Ops): We need: 1) manager justification (one para), 2) suggested salary and band, 3) proposed effective_date (note payroll cutoff), 4) equity request (if any), 5) headcount tag = "existing". Also add recent performance notes (1-2 bullets).
Marta (Compensation): For IC2 -> IC3, target midpoint in the band is $160k. What's the requested salary?
Jules (Eng Manager): Requesting $155,000 base. Alex is currently at $142k.
Marta (Compensation): OK that sits between midpoint and 25th percentile of next band. We'll need comp committee sign-off because it's >10% increase. Please include benchmark justification (comp data, market source).
Jules (Eng Manager): Noted. What's the approval chain and SLA? I don't want to promise an effective date we can't hit.
Priya (People Ops): Chain: manager -> people ops triage -> leveling committee (1-2 business days) -> comp committee if >10% or crosses band (2 business days) -> payroll. SLA: typically 3-5 business days unless escalated. Off-cycle payroll possible but needs Finance/Payroll signoff.
Ben (Payroll): Payroll cutoff for US salaried runs is 4 business days before pay date for changes that affect the next run. If approvals are late we can do an off-cycle payment but that triggers additional processing fees and requires a memo + cost center approval.
Jules (Eng Manager): Can the effective date be retroactive to the start of this month (2026-03-01)?
Priya (People Ops): Retroactive effective dates are allowed but we prefer not to. If retroactive, confirm final approval and paperwork arrived before payroll closes for that pay period, otherwise it will hit the next run or require off-cycle. Retro pay is possible but treated as a separate adjustment (taxed in the period it's paid).
Marta (Compensation): Also note equity: if you want a pro-rated grant on promotion, that must be requested now. Equity committee runs weekly; if approved we can set grant_date = promotion effective_date. For US employees, stock withholding paperwork required.
Jules (Eng Manager): I'll submit a promotion packet now. One more: do managers communicate promotions before committee approval?
Priya (People Ops): Please do NOT promise comp/level until committee + comp approvals are finalized. You can communicate "pending promotion review" and expected timeline. If you need a fast approval for retention risk, flag "expedite" in the form with reason.
PeopleOpsBot: Promotion packet form: https://redwood.company/hr/leveling_packet. For >10% increases set field `needs_comp_committee = true`. To expedite, add `expedite_reason`.
Jules (Eng Manager): Submitted packet with justification and market comps. Marked expedite due to retention risk.
Priya (People Ops): Got it. Routing to leveling committee now. ETA 24-48 hours for initial decision.
Marta (Compensation): Reviewing now. Quick checklist: confirm manager justification, attach recent performance summary, confirm budget code. If approved by leveling committee, routing to comp committee tomorrow morning.
Jules (Eng Manager): Budget code is ENG-RD-23. Attached.
Ben (Payroll): Small logistics: when this goes through, we need HRIS update for job profile + effective_date. Please indicate whether to create a new job record or update existing (for promotions we usually update job profile). Also include employee SSN last 4 for payroll feed.
Priya (People Ops): FYI if the promotion crosses country pay bands (e.g., remote location change) comp committee will require market adjustment rationale.
Jules (Eng Manager): Alex is still in the US, same location.
Marta (Compensation): Leveling committee approved IC3. Comp committee meeting in 18 hours. If comp committee approves $155k, then Payroll cutoff applies.
Jules (Eng Manager): Fingers crossed. If comp committee approves after cutoff, can we retroactively pay from 2026-03-01?
Ben (Payroll): If approval arrives after cutoff we can issue retro pay in the next regular run as an adjustment. Off-cycle is possible but needs Finance sign-off and fee approval. Retro pay will be taxed in the run it is paid and will show as an adjustment on the employee's YTD.
Priya (People Ops): Final note: once approved, People Ops will generate the official promotion confirmation email template (manager to send) and the updated comp letter. Please don't send any draft salary numbers before transcripts are final.
Jules (Eng Manager): Understood. Thanks all. Will wait for comp committee.
Marta (Compensation): Comp committee approved $155k and pro-rated equity. Priya, please prepare offer doc and notify payroll.
Priya (People Ops): Preparing docs now. Ben, requested effective_date = 2026-03-01, but if payroll cutoff missed we'll schedule retro adjustment.
Ben (Payroll): Copy. I'll watch for final approval and prepare payroll feed.
Jules (Eng Manager): Communicated to Alex as "approved and paperwork in process" per guidance. Thanks everyone :heart:
